request.query: Subtract distinct integer multivariate polynomials with nonnegative coefficients bounded by B, obtaining nonzero polynomial with absolute coefficients bounded by B

items.name: IsPoly.below.sub
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {motive : (a : (α → ℕ) → ℤ) → IsPoly a → Prop} {f g : (α → ℕ) → ℤ} (a : IsPoly f) (a_1 : IsPoly g),
  IsPoly.below a → motive f a → IsPoly.below a_1 → motive g a_1 → IsPoly.below ⋯

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_sub
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} (σ : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (p q : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (p - q) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p - MvPolynomial.coeff m q

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_sub
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) {q : MvPolynomial σ R} (f : σ → R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval f) (p - q) = (MvPolynomial.eval f) p - (MvPolynomial.eval f) q

items.name: Poly.sub_apply
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f g : Poly α) (x : α → ℕ), (f - g) x = f x - g x

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_sub
